results.title: Avengers: Doomsday
results.overview: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

results.title: The Last Sunrise
results.overview: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

results.original_title: 剑来院线剧场版 十三之争

results.title: Avengers: Secret Wars
results.overview: An upcoming film in Phase Six of the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) and the finale of The Multiverse Saga.

results.title: The Dog Stars
results.overview: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

results.title: Dune: Part Three
results.overview: Emperor Paul Atreides faces the fallout from his ascent to power as political plots and a galaxy-wide holy war endanger the future only he can see.

results.title: Fast Forever
results.overview: The eleventh and final installment in The Fast Saga. Plot TBA.

results.title: Ghost Soldier
results.overview: Reclusive government asset Henry Fitzgerald is living off the grid in Wyoming, designing new systems for a weapons research agency. When a multi trillion dollar investment management firm begins employing corrupt police and foreign mercenaries to force farmers off their ranches, the Green Beret veteran decides to employ his weapon prototypes to assist his neighbors.

results.title: Resident Evil
results.overview: Bryan, a medical courier, unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

results.title: Heart of the Beast
results.overview: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

results.title: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-ups
results.overview: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

results.title: Forgotten Island
results.overview: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

results.title: Possible Love
results.overview: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

results.title: Practical Magic 2
results.overview: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

results.title: Bokshi
results.overview: Anahita, traumatised by the brutal disappearance of her mother, finds comfort in Shalini, her history teacher. On an unconventional school excursion to a mysterious prehistoric site, she confronts her terrifying destiny.

results.title: Secret File
results.overview: A secret archive documenting the earliest revolutionary work of the Chinese Communist Party—the "Central Archives"—was successfully protected through the resilience and sacrifices of its guardians (both Party members and non-members) amid the turmoil and bloodshed from 1931 to 1949.

results.title: Ice Age: Boiling Point
results.overview: This dinosaur-and-lava-filled madcap adventure takes Manny, Sid, Diego, Ellie, Buck, acorn-obsessed Scrat – this time joined by Baby Scrat and the enormous Jurassic Scrat – and the rest of the herd to visit never before-seen corners of the treacherous Lost World.

results.title: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse
results.overview: Hunted by Miguel O'Hara's Spider Society and betrayed by his friends, Miles finds himself in the darkest corners of the Spider-Verse in search of a way home. Knowing that his family has been not only fractured but endangered by his calling, it's a race against the clock for Miles to travel across the wildest reaches of time and space to fight for and reunite everything he holds most dear.

results.title: Verity
results.overview: Lowen Ashleigh gets hired by Jeremy Crawford to ghostwrite novels for his bestselling author wife Verity, who's unable to finish after an accident. Lowen uncovers Verity's disturbing truths while residing at the Crawfords' home to work.

results.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 4
results.overview: Sonic the Hedgehog, joined by a new hero named Amy, faces a new technological nemesis known as Metal Sonic.
